Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That's it from the coverage of this game. Afghanistan Under-19 will face England Under-19 in the semi-finals. They have a couple of days to prepare for that game. Although the U-19 World Cup action will continue on 29th January as Pakistan Under-19 take on Australia Under-19 in Quarter Final 3. The first ball will be bowled at 6.30 pm IST (1.00 pm GMT). But the build-up will begin much in advance. Do join us for that. Till then, take care and goodbye!

Suliman Safi, the victorious skipper, is in for a chat. He says, the boys played really well. Adds that, he is happy with how the players performed under pressure. Mentions, they will try to score big with the blade in the next fixture.

Dunith Wellalage, the skipper of Sri Lanka U-19, is in for a chat. Firstly he congratulates the Afghanistan team for playing well. Mentions that he is proud of his team. Tells that they committed a few mistakes and the four run-outs cost them the match. Ends by saying that Vinuja Ranpul and Traveen Mathews bowled really well and those were the few positives.

Noor Ahmad win the Man of the Match award for his exceptional hitting with the blade. He says that he tried to swing his blade and get some biggies and help his team put a good total. Mentions that his skipper told them that the wicket is not easy for batting and if they didn't make a good total, even Sri Lanka would not chase it.
Stay tuned for presentation...

Earlier in the first innings, after being put to bat. Afghanistan started off with the blade on the wrong foot. A crucial stand in the middle order and some lusty blows by Noor Ahmad made sure to cross the 130-runs mark. Later with the ball, Afghanistan Under-19 bowlers kept things tight and astonishingly made it to next round.

Afghanistan Under-19 won hearts but in the end also managed to win the game. This was an exceptional performance by the bowlers. They wanted quick wickets and their pair of seamers got them off to a flying start. Within 12 over SL were 24/4. Afghanistan Under-19 were exceptional in the field as well, they kept things tight really well and hence were rewarded with three run outs as well. But the extras conceded by the bowlers could've haunted them as well but a late, late run-out took them over the line.

Sri Lanka came out to chase down a modest score, but they made a mountain out of a molehill and that costed them the game. The lack of partnerships in the middle hurt them a lot. The eighth wicket stand though of 69 runs came to rescue for Sri Lanka Under-19 but once it was broken they lost wickets in cluster to make it difficult for them. In the end, an indecision in the fag end of the innings confirmed their departure back home. It was really a sorry performance by Sri Lanka Under-19. But they will surely learn a lot from this game.

WHAT JUST HAPPENED HERE! Some passionate fight shown by Afghanistan U-19 players to turn the game around in their favour. Jubilation for Afghanistan and tragedy for Sri Lanka. No one would’ve expected this result after watching the first innings but this is what cricket is all about.

OUT! RUN OUT! What a game of cricket! Jubilation for Afghanistan Under-19. Tragedy for Sri Lanka Under-19. Afghanistan players are running all around the park. They cannot believe it. Naveed Zadran has got emotional and is on the ground. Sri Lanka Under-19 only have themselves to blame. 134 to defend and Afghanistan Under-19 showed 'never give up' attitude and now will enter the semis. They never stopped believing in themselves, always maintained the pressure and have got the desired result. Coming to the ball, it was a back-of-a-length ball, around off. Vinuja Ranpul stands up on his toes and dabs this towards backward point. There was never a run there but Traveen Mathews starts running and is halfway down the pitch. Nangeyalia Kharote underarms the ball to the bowler. He runs back and then underarms it to the stumps of his end and Traveen Mathews is caught well short of the crease. AFGHANISTAN UNDER-19 WIN BY 4 RUNS!
And again! Length ball, outside off, angling away. Vinuja Ranpul has a poke at it but misses.
So close! Good-length ball, angling away, outside off. Vinuja Ranpul looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Short of a length, outside off. Vinuja Ranpul looks to cut but under-edges it to point.

FOUR! Excellent shot! That's going to run away! Vinuja Ranpul is playing like a top-order batsman. Width on offer again, outside off. Vinuja Ranpul latches onto it and slashes powerfully through point for a boundary. Just 5 runs away are Sri Lanka Under-19 to win this match and enter the semis.
Two! This is good batting! Width on offer, outside off. Vinuja Ranpul carves it to deep point. He pushes hard for the second run and gets it comfortably.
Full and on off, patted back to the bowler. Sri Lanka Under-19 camp with their hands over their heads in tension. Nail-biting stuff! 11 needed with 1 wicket in hand!
Flatter ball, outside off. Traveen Mathews defends it to the off side.
Floats it up, outside off. Driven towards covers.
Loopy ball, on middle. Traveen Mathews defends it out.
On middle, kept out.
Tossed up, on off. Vinuja Ranpul tucks it to deep square leg for a single.

Length ball, angling down leg. Vinuja Ranpul looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls to short fine leg and the batters take a leg bye. Loud appeal from Bilal Sami for an lbw but the umpire is not interested.
Short of a length, on middle. Traveen Mathews hops and taps it to point. Good running between the wickets. Good call from the non striker and the response was immediate.

Two! Full and on the pads. Traveen Mathews flicks it to deep square leg for a couple of runs. Sri Lanka Under-19 getting closer here. 14 needed to win. Afghanistan Under-19 searching for that one wicket here.
On a good length, outside off. Traveen Mathews looks to cut but misses.
Length ball, outside off. Vinuja Ranpul looks dabs it to third man. There is a fumble in the deep but the batters settle for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Vinuja Ranpul goes for the booming drive but misses.
Flighted ball, on middle. Clipped to mid-wicket.
Full and on off, driven straight to cover.
WIDE! Fires this one down the leg side, Traveen Mathews looks to work it on the leg side but misses. Wided.
Loopy ball, on off. Mathews keeps it out.
Full again, on middle. Driven towards covers.
Full and outside off, pushed to point.
Flatter and quicker, on middle. Traveen Mathews blocks it out.
Full, on off. Mathews pushes it to mid on. There is a misfield and the batters scamper through for a single.
Traveen Mathews is the last batsman to come in.

OUT! TIMBER! Another set batsman departs. The googly does the trick in Izharulhaq Naveed's final over. Sri Lanka Under-19 are nine wickets down now. Izharulhaq Naveed serves a googly, on middle. Raveen de Silva misses it completely. The ball goes through to shatter the stumps behind him. The Afghanistan players are delighted. They are just one wicket away from getting a ticket to the semis.
Full, on off. Pushed to mid on for a single.
Flatter and on off. Raveen de Silva punches it through covers for a single.
Tossed up, full and on off. Vinuja Ranpul works it past the slip fielder off the outside edge. They take a single.
Googly, full and outside off. Vinuja Ranpul looks to defend it out but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Full and on off. Ranpul works it to third man off the outside edge for a single. He gets off the mark instantly.
Vinuja Ranpul walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Oh no, late drama. This game is full of surprises. Nangeyalia Kharote does the trick and finds a major breakthrough. Short and wide outside off. Dunith Wellalage stays back and cuts it hard towards point but straight down the throat of Naveed Zadran, who makes no mistake. Afghanistan Under-19 believe once again. Can they build on this breakthrough?
Commentary.Howout: c Allah Noor b Nangeyalia Kharote

On off, blocked out.
Short and outside off, Raveen de Silva tries to cut it hard but fails to connect.

Fuller, outside off. Pushed towards covers.
Flatter ball, on middle. Dunith Wellalage pokes it to point for a sharp single.

Length ball, on off. Dunith Wellalage taps it to point for a single.

Raveen de Silva is on the ground here. Looks he has an issue with his hamstring here. The physio comes out to have a look. Will he be able to continue? The physio thinks he should be good to stay in the middle.

A low full toss, on middle. Raveen de Silva flicks it to mid-wicket. A poor single but no harm done. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Had that hit, it would have been curtains for Raveen de Silva. He was out by five yards. Not even in the frame. He gets away with this one. Sri Lanka Under-19 would not want a run out at this stage.
On a length, outside off. Dunith Wellalage pushes it to deep point for a single.
WIDE! These wide deliveries are going to haunt Afghanistan Under-19. Short ball, on middle. Dunith Wellalage sways away from the line. Wide called for height.
Length ball, on middle. Dunith Wellalage defends it out.
Full and outside off, steered to deep point for a single.
Floats it up, on off. Dunith Wellalage prods and looks to defend but misss. He gets thudded on the pads. A huge appeal from Noor Ahmad but the umpire is unmoved. That looked really close.
Tossed up, outside off. Dunith Wellalage looks to drive but gets beaten on the outside edge.
WIDE! Yet another wide from the bowler. Short and way down the leg side. Dunith Wellalage looks to pull but misses. The wide tally moves to 30 now. 100 up for Sri Lanka Under-19 as well.
Slower ball, outside off. Left alone.
Spinning away, outside off. Dunith Wellalage looks to cut but misses.
What a ball! Flatter delivery, outside off, turning away. Dunith Wellalage looks to defend. The ball zips past the outside edge. Classic leg-break delivery.
Outside off, Raveen de Silva leaves it alone. Just inside the tramline. Sri Lanka Under-19 need 36 runs more.
Slower through the air, on off. Raveen de Silva goes back and blocks it out solidly.
Full and on off. Raveen de Silva presses forward and defends it out.
Flighted, full and wide outside off, Raveen de Silva leaves it alone. Not a wide.
On off, pushed to cover for a single.
WIDE! Full and wide outside off. Dunith Wellalage walks across and the umpire signals a wide.
Looped up, full and on off, drifts in. Dunith Wellalage looks to defend it out but gets hit on his pads. Naveed appeals but the umpire says no.
A maiden for Noor Ahmad. Flighted, full and on leg. Raveen de Silva remains solid in his defense and sees off this over.
Five dots in a row! Full and on off. Raveen de Silva strides to push it to the left of the bowler.
Tossed up, wide outside off. Raveen de Silva leaves it alone.
Full and outside off. Raveen de Silva pushes it to cover.
Full and on off. Raveen de Silva defends it back to the bowler.
Tossed up, around middle, drifts in a hint. Raveen de Silva gets pinged on the pads. The keeper moves to his left to collect the ball. Ahmad appeals but the umpire is unmoved.

On middle, blocked to mid on.
Flatter and outside off. Dunith Wellalage shuffles across and leaves it alone for the keeper.
Full and outside off. Blocked to covers.
Full and outside off. Defended to point.

FOUR! Misfield and all of a sudden thinks are going Sri Lanka's way. Full and outside off. Dunith Wellalage slaps it down the ground. The fielder at mid off moves to his left but dives over the ball. It runs away to the fence at long off.
Tossed up, full and on off. Raveen de Silva strides forward to defend it out and gets an inside edge onto the pads. Ahmad thinks otherwise and puts in an appeal but the umpire is unmoved.

FIVE WIDES! This has been the issue for Afghanistan Under-19. Full and down leg. Raveen de Silva misses his flick. The keeper cannot do anything here. The ball runs away to the fence at fine leg and the umpire signals a wide.

On off, at the stumps. Dunith Wellalage goes back and defends it out watchfully.
Full, on off. Raveen de Silva flicks it to the leg side. Just one run off it.
BEATEN! Slower through the air, outside off, it drifts away. Raveen de Silva looks to defend it out but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Flighted, full and on middle, it is played back to the bowler.
Full, on middle and leg, Dunith Wellalage works it to mid on for an easy single.
Around off, drifts in off the deck. Dunith Wellalage goes back and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Floated, full and outside off. Dunith Wellalage leans in and defends it to cover.
A dot to end the over! Just a single from the over. Flatter ball, outside off. Raveen de Silva leaves it alone. 53 needed from 120 balls.
Full again, on the pads. Defended out.
Full and on leg, pushed back to the bowler.
Quicker again, outside off, turning back in. Raveen de Silva offers no shot.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Left alone.

Flighted ball, outside off. Driven to sweeper cover for a single.
Outside off, Raveen de Silva offers no shot.
Loopy ball, outside off. Raveen de Silva looks to defend. The ball goes off the outside half to point.
Full and on middle, pushed through point for a run.
Full and outside off, left alone.
Full, around middle and leg. Raveen de Silva presses forward to block it back to the bowler. Three dots in a row to end the over.

Full, around middle and leg. Raveen de Silva defends it to cover off the front foot.

Fuller, down leg. Raveen de Silva flicks it to deep square leg for a brace. Afghanistan Under-19 need a wicket to put to put the pressure back on the batters. The runs here will help Sri Lanka Under-19 to grow in confidence.
BEATEN! A length ball, on top of off. Raveen de Silva gets squared up as he looks to defend it out but gets beaten by the away movement.
Full, on the stumps. Raveen de Silva defends it to cover.

FOUR! First boundary off the blade for Sri Lanka Under-19. A length ball, outside off. Raveen de Silva looks to drive it away. The ball takes the outside edge and goes past the slip fielder for a boundary at third man.
Fuller, on leg. Raveen de Silva defends it to mid on.

Loud appeal for a caught behind but the umpire is unmoved. Flatter and quicker ball, outside off. Dunith Wellalage looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge. Huge appeal but turned down by the umpire.
Outside off, straightens up after pitching. Dunith Wellalage looks to work on the leg side but misses.
Outside off, Dunith Wellalage defends it to the off side.

Width offered, outside off. Dunith Wellalage guides it to deep point for one.
Floats it up, on off. Pushed back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, driven towards covers for a single.

THREE WIDES! Full and way too outside off. The keeper and the first slip fielder fail to collect the ball and it rolls to third man. The batters run two. This was wide number 22. Looks like the extras have been batting for Sri Lanka Under-19.
On off, was a quicker one. Dunith Wellalage taps it to point.
WIDE! Spraying down the leg side. The umpire calls it a wide.
Floats it up, on off. Dunith Wellalage taps it to backward point.
WIDE! Full and way too outside off. Left alone. Wided.

Shortish, outside off. Raveen de Silva looks to cut but misses. 20 overs have been bowled and Sri Lanka Under-19 are yet to score their first boundary. They have lost 7 wickets as well. This shows how well Afghanistan Under-19 has been.
Loopy ball, on middle and leg. Raveen de Silva looks to defend but gets hit on the pads. Izharulhaq Naveed appeals for an lbw but the umpire is unmoved.
Flighted ball, outside off. Raveen de Silva looks to drive but misses.
Flatter ball, on off. Raveen de Silva blocks it out.

LEG BYE! Fuller, on leg. Raveen de Silva misses his flick and gets it towards fine leg off his pads. They collect a leg bye.
Short and outside off. Raveen de Silva looks to cut it away but misses.

OUT! RUN OUT! Another one bites the dust. That dropped catch doesn't cost anything and Afghanistan Under-19 are up celebrating. Jubilation for them and it looks all over for Sri Lanka Under-19 now. A googly, outside off. Dunith Wellalage pokes at it and the ball goes off the outside edge past the keeper. It lobs of the flap of the keeper and goes over first slip. The short third man gets across but there is a lot of hesitation between the batters whether to take the single or no. Ultimately, Dunith Wellalage sends his partner back who is caught ball watching. Nangeyalia Kharote throws the ball at the bowler's end and Abdul Hadi whips the bails off in flash. The umpire take it upstairs and the replay shows that Yasiru Rodrigo is caught short of the crease.
Is that a run out? The replays roll in to confirm Yasiru Rodrigo was way short off the crease.

DROPPED! Finally something goes Sri Lanka's way here. Tossed up, full and outside off. Rodrigo hangs his blade out and gets an outside edge. The man at first slip gets low to his left but fails to gather the ball.
Angled in, full and on off. Rodrigo presses forward and works it to short fine leg with his wrists.

WIDE! Full and outside the tramline. Wide called.

Floated, full and outside off. Rodrigo pushes it to cover.

OUT! RUN OUT! Afghanistan Under-19 very much in charge right now and they are all pumped up. Chamindu Wickramasinghe has been there right from the start and was involved in a run out as well but this time becomes the victim himself. Credit to Afghanistan Under-19 players for putting such a show. They have not given up and showed tremendous character. What a fightback from the youngsters. They are celebrating like they have won the ticket to semi final. Not yet, but are inching closer. Coming to the ball, it was quick and outside off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe works it to mid off for a quick single. He didn't run in straight line and Suliman Safi quickly picked up the ball and scored a direct hit at the bowler's end in one motion. The umpires take it upstairs and the replay suggests that Chamindu Wickramasinghe was caught short by a few centimetres. He has to continue his walk back to the pavilion. Sri Lanka Under-19 lose their sixth wicket.
Is that a run out? The umpire consults the TV umpire here. The replays roll in to confirm Chamindu Wickramasinghe was not over the line as the wickets were hit. The final decision is OUT.
Full and quick, outside off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe drives it to long on for one.
A googly, outside off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe defends it out.

FIVE WIDES! The keeper has got to do well in such small run chase. Sri Lanka Under-19 gets their first boundary and that too off a wide delivery. Izharulhaq Naveed sprays this one down the leg side, Mohammad Ishaq fails to collect the ball and it races away to the fine leg fence.
Another googly, on middle and leg. Chamindu Wickramasinghe blocks it out.
A googly, on off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe defends it with soft hands.

Flighted ball, on leg. Yasiru Rodrigo tucks it off the inside edge to square leg for a single.

WIDE! Full and down the leg side. Yasiru Rodrigo looks to flick but misses. The ball goes off the keeper's boots and flies to short fine leg. The first slip fielder catches the ball diving to his right but the umpire calls it a wide.

What a start by Noor Ahmad. Just a single and a wicket off it. He ends the over with a googly, on leg. Chamindu Wickramasinghe shuffles across and gets pinged on his pads. Noor Ahmad appeals but the umpire is unmoved this time. Going down leg.
Around off. Yasiru Rodrigo taps it to point for a quick single.
Flatter and wide outside off. Yasiru Rodrigo does not chase it.
Full and outside off, left alone.
Yasiru Rodrigo is the new batsman in.

OUT! LBW! Noor Ahmad works his magic and strikes on his very second delivery. Sri Lanka Under-19 crumbling here. Floated. full and on off. Ranuda Somarathne goes deep inside in his crease, as he looks to defend it out but gets hit on his pads. That is dead plumb, Ahmad knows it. He appeals and the umpire agrees in a flash. This is a top-class performance by the bowlers.
Tossed up, full and on leg. Ranuda Somarathne looks to sweep but misses. It goes to short fine leg off the pads.

Drinks! Afghanistan Under-19 are putting up an inspirational performance here. The pacers kept bowling on those probing line and lengths and have got 4 wickets already. Sri Lanka Under-19 look in all sorts of trouble at the moment. That 135 must be looking like a mountain from here. They need a partnership to get going while Afghanistan Under-19 will now look to introduce their spinners to put Sri Lanka Under-19 further on the back foot. A bowling change. Time for some spin as Noor Ahmad comes into the attack.
A length ball, outside off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe gets squared up and gets it towards gully off the outside edge.

Fuller, wide outside off. Ranuda Somarathne drives it through the cover region. The fielder does well to save the boundary. The batters take three. The wait continues for the first boundary. Afghanistan Under-19 giving it their all in the field as well.
Length ball, outside off. Ranuda Somarathne gets behind and pushes it to mid off. Sri Lanka Under-19 yet to find the first boundary of the chase.
Full length, down leg. Chamindu Wickramasinghe glances it down to fine leg. The batters take a single. Good over by Bilal Sami in the deep to keep it down only for a single.
Fuller, outside off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe blocks it out to cover.
WIDE! Length ball, angled across, outside off. The umpire calls it as a wide.
Outside off, left alone.
Just a single off the over then! The pacers have set a beautiful platform for Afghanistan Under-19. A length ball, outside off. Ranuda Somarathne defends it to the off side off the outer half.
Fuller, on off. Ranuda Somarathne guides it towards backward point.
Fuller, on off, nips in a bit. Ranuda Somarathne flicks it to the leg side watchfully. This was super close.
Fuller, on off. Ranuda Somarathne defends it out solidly.
Full length, outside off. Ranuda Somarathne tries to drive it down the ground but gets it towards cover off the outer half.
Very full, on middle. Chamindu Wickramasinghe squeezes it to the leg side.
Good length, outside off. Ranuda Somarathne leaves it alone for the keeper.
Ranuda Somarathne walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Finally Zadran gets a reward. Anjala Bandara has to walk back after a short stay here. Afghanistan Under-19 right on top here. They are giving it their everything. A good-length ball, outside off, angled across the left-hander. Anjala Bandara was farely new at the crease and was hence tempted to go after it, only to nick it back for the keeper. Mohammad Ishaq continues the good work behind the stumps and takes an easy catch to spoil the mood in the Sri Lanka Under-19 camp.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Ishaq b Naveed Zadran

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, on off. Bandara blocks it back to the bowler.
Fuller, just outside off. Bandara pushes it out solidly.
Length ball, on the stumps. Bandara gets it off the outer half.
Length ball, on the pads. Chamindu Wickramasinghe flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Full length, wide outside off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe works it towards third man for a single.
Full and outside off. Anjala Bandara reaches out for it and slices it to deep point for a single.
On a length, on off. Defended to the off side.
Down the leg side. Wide called.
Full, wide outside off. Anjala Bandara pushes it out.
Anjala Bandara walks out to bat.

OUT! RUN OUT! The pressure of dot balls got to the batters and a risky run has costed them another wicket. Sri Lanka Under-19 now three down. It is all going downhill for them. Full ball, on off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe clips it towards mid on. Chamindu Wickramasinghe called for a single as soon as he hit that but Sakuna Liyanage was ball watching at the other end and was late into his run up. Noor Ahmad collects the ball and throws it towards the keeper. Mohammad Ishaq gathers the ball and removes the bails. The umpire takes it upstairs to confirm and replays roll in favour of Afghanistan Under-19.

A run out appeal has been sent upstairs. Replay shows that Mohammad Ishaq whipped the bails off before Sakuna Liyanage could get back inside the crease. Was short by a few centimetres there but will have to depart. The third umpire confirms the same by showing OUT on the big screen.
Full and on off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe taps it to covers.
End of Powerplay 1! That means now, 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle until the end of the 40th over.

Full and outside off. Sakuna Liyanage looks to drive but misses. A maiden for Naveed Zadran. He is really troubling the batters with his line and lengths. He has gone past the outside edge countless number of times now.
Sharp seam movement, outside off. Sakuna Liyanage gets beaten yet again.
And again! An outswinger, outside off, going past the outside edge of Sakuna.
Naveed Zadran going past the outside edge for the umpteenth time now. On a good length, outside off. Sakuna Liyanage looks to defend. The ball whizzes past the outside edge.
On middle, Sakuna Liyanage blocks it out.
Gone past the edge again! Length ball, outside off, shaping away. Sakuna Liyanage looks to defend. The ball zips past the outside edge. Naveed Zadran gives him a stare.
Outside off, on a length. Chamindu Wickramasinghe defends it on the leg side.
Comes 'round the wicket and bowls a short ball, on middle. Chamindu Wickramasinghe ducks under it.
Fuller, on leg. Chamindu Wickramasinghe looks to flick but misses. He gets hit on the pads. Bilal Sami appeals for an lbw but the umpire says no. Might be pitching outside leg.
On a length, on off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe defends it to the off side with soft hands.

On a length, on middle. Sakuna Liyanage clips it on the leg side for a quick single. Bilal Sami quickly collects the ball and fires a throw at the striker's end but misses. A direct hit would have been interesting.
WIDE! Afghanistan Under-19 are bowling well but they are conceding too many runs via wide balls. Length ball, down the leg side. Left alone.
Length ball, on off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe chips it to wide of mid on for a single.

On a length, outside off. Sakuna Liyanage looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge. A stifled appeal for caught behind but nothing from the umpire. Afghanistan Under-19 keeping things very tight here.
On middle, clipped to mid-wicket for one.
WIDE! On a length, way too outside off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe lets it go. Wided.
Short of a length, on off. Blocked out by Chamindu.
On a length, on middle. Chamindu Wickramasinghe defends it on the leg side.
Good-length ball, on off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe defends it back to the bowler.
Fuller, wide of outside off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe is not interested in playing that.
On a length, on middle. Nicely tucked down to fine leg for a single.
Short ball, on middle. Chamindu Wickramasinghe sits under it.
Length ball, on off. Defended back onto the pitch.
On a good length, outside off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe leaves it for the keeper to collect.
Fuller, outside off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe works it to mid on.
Length ball, outside off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe lets it sail through.
And again! Length ball, outside off, angling across. Sakuna Liyanage looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge. High quality bowling this!
Absolute beauty! A ripper! Good-length ball, on middle and off, shaping away. Sakuna Liyanage looks to defend as he is forced to play at it. The ball whitles past the outside edge.
Wide outside off, shaping away. Left alone by Sakuna Liyanage. This is some quality bowling from the pacers of Afghanistan Under-19.
On middle, Chamindu Wickramasinghe turns it behind square on the leg side for a single.
On a length, on off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe defends it towards covers.
Wide outside off, Chamindu Wickramasinghe leaves it alone for the keeper.
Back of a length, around off. Sakuna Liyanage sways away from the line to see off the over.
Fuller, on leg. Chamindu Wickramasinghe flicks it through mid-wicket for three runs. Good running. Also, Noor Ahmad does well to save a run for his side here.
A sharp bouncer, on off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe ducks under it.
Good length, wide outside off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe looks to chase it but misses.
EDGY! Full length, outside off. Sakuna Liyanage strides in and gets an inside edge to fine leg. They take a single.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Sakuna Liyanage leaves it alone. Wide called.
Sakuna Liyanage is the new batsman in.

OUT! TIMBER! Shevon Daniel's struggle comes to an end here. He was looking very cautious in the middle and Bilal Sami was quick to pounce on the opportunity. A full-length ball, on middle. Shevon Daniel looks to dig it out but misses, it goes through his defence to shatter the stumps. Bilal Sami here pulling off a Vinuja Ranpul's innings to get his side back in the contest.
Fuller, on off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe looks to flick it to the leg side. The ball fizzed off the outside edge towards point. This has been a brilliant start by Afghanistan Under-19.
Three dots in a row! Good length, on off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe blocks it out back to the bowler.
On a length, outside off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe taps it towards point.
Full-length, wide outside off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe reaches out but fails to get any blade on it.
Length ball, on off. Daniel works it towards point off the outer half. The batters take a single as the fielder fumbles.
Good-length ball, around off, angling across the left-hander. Shevon Daniel gets beaten on the outside edge.
Just 2 runs off the over! Full length, outside off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe gets his blade down in time and defends it to the off side.
Good length, on off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe blocks it back to the bowler.
Touch short, on the pads, Daniel clips it to square leg for a single.
Good length, outside off, Daniel looks to chase it but misses.

Good take by Mohammad Ishaq behind the stumps. This is a length ball, on the pads. Shevon Daniel looks to flick it but misses, it flies off the thigh pad to the right of the keeper. Mohammad Ishaq dives to his right to gather the ball.
Fuller, outside off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe pushes it to mid off with soft hands and scampers across for a quick single.
Good length, just outside off. Shevon Daniel looks to defend it out. The ball zips past the outside edge.
Fuller, on middle. Chamindu Wickramasinghe flicks it to mid-wicket for a quick single.
BEAUTY! Back of a length, around middle, angling across the left-hander. Chamindu Wickramasinghe hangs his blade out and gets beaten on the outside edge. This is amazing bowling.
Good length, on the fourth stump line. Chamindu Wickramasinghe shuffles across and blocks it out.
Outside off, left alone for the keeper.
WIDE! Good length, wide outside off, shaping away but outside the tramline. Chamindu Wickramasinghe looks to chase it but misses.
WIDE! Short ball, outside off, moving away sharply with some extra bounce. Wide called.
BEATEN! What a start for Naveed Zadran. Back of a length, outside off, moving away off the deck. Chamindu Wickramasinghe looks to push it to the off side but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Naveed Zadran to operate from the other end.
A brilliant end to the over by Sami! A length ball, on middle, nips in a touch. Shevon Daniel gets an inside edge onto the pads. Sri Lanka Under-19 2 for 1 after the first over.
Full length, wide outside off. Shevon Daniel hits the bat on the ground, as went to chase it away from his body.
Shevon Daniel walks out to bat at No.3.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Bilal Sami strikes in the very first over and this is the start Afghanistan Under-19 were after. Sadisha Rajapaksa goes back on a golden duck. Good-length ball, outside off, shaping away off the deck. Shevon Daniel looks to go after it but only manages it to feather it towards the keeper. Mohammad Ishaq takes a sharp catch behind the stumps.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Ishaq b Bilal Sami

Commentary.Commentary: Tap and run! Full, on off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe taps it out on the leg side for a quick single.
WIDE! Back of a length, wide outside off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe does not go after it. The umpire signals a wide. Sri Lanka Under-19 off the mark with a freebie.
A length ball, outside off, shaping away. Chamindu Wickramasinghe leaves it alone.

A dot to start with! Full-length ball, wide outside off. Chamindu Wickramasinghe looks to drive it away but misses and hits the blade on the ground. Bilal Sami puts in an appeal because he thinks the sound was off the edge but that was not the case and the umpire turned it down.
